description: Flood, water extent and rainfall products: Yemen is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: FL20240812YEM This map illustrates satellite-detected water extent in Al Hodeidah Governorate, Yemen as observed from a Sentinel-2 satellite image acquired on 07 August 2024 at 10:59 local time. Within the cloud free analysed areas of about 20,000 km², a total of about 450 km² of lands appear to be affected with flood waters. Coverage: Yemen. The portal lists 6 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 3 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP, XLSX. The portal shows 2024-08-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
